lemma euclidean_excludes (ht : EuclideanAsymptotic F A) (hA : 0<A) (t : Collection) :
    ¬ euclidean F =ᶠ[past] atPoint t := by
    intro h; apply hA.ne'
    apply no_powerlog (real_profile t 0)
    have he : Tendsto _ _ (𝓝 (A:ℂ).re) := (Complex.continuous_re.tendsto _).comp ht
    apply he.congr'; filter_upwards [h] with i hi; rw [comp_apply]; rw [hi,Complex.real_smul, mul_re,ofReal_re,ofReal_im]; ring

proof_context.conclusion: If `EuclideanAsymptotic F A` with `0 < A`, then `euclidean F` is not eventually equal on `𝓝[>] 0` to `atPoint t` for any finite collection `t`.

lemma no_powerlog {f : ℝ→ℝ} {A : ℝ} (hp : AtOrder f 0) (ht : Tendsto (fun s=> (s^8 * (Real.log s⁻¹)^2)*f s) past (𝓝 A)) : A=0 := by
    obtain ⟨u,w,h⟩:=hp
    apply board_limit w
    have he : Tendsto life atTop past := tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff.mpr ⟨tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num), Eventually.of_forall fun i=> by change 0<life i; unfold life; positivity⟩
    have hh := ht.comp he
    have hy (n) : share (life n)=act ⟨0,0⟩*P ⟨0,0⟩ n := by
       rw [← singleValue]; simp [joint,tile]
    have hv : Tendsto (fun n=> share (life n)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
        simp_rw [hy]; simpa only [mul_zero] using (negligible ⟨0,0⟩ (by norm_num [degree])).const_mul (act ⟨0,0⟩)
    have hr : Tendsto (fun n=> share (life n)*(f-u) (life n)) atTop (𝓝 0) := by
        apply ((isBigO_of_le atTop (f:=fun n=> share (life n)) (g:=fun n=> share (life n)) (fun _=> le_rfl)).mul (h.comp_tendsto he)).trans_tendsto
        simpa only [tile,zpow_zero, Function.comp_apply,mul_one] using hv
    have hq:= hh.sub hr; rw [sub_zero] at hq; apply hq.congr; intro n; change share _ * f _ - share _ * (f _- u _)=_; ring

proof_context.conclusion: If `f` is a finite power-log expansion with `AtOrder f 0` and `s^8 log(1/s)^2 f(s) → A`, then `A = 0`, by comparing the leading terms.

lemma real_profile (x : Collection) : Expands (fun p=>(atPoint x p).re) := by
    induction x with
    | nil => simp only [atPoint,List.map_nil,List.sum_nil,zero_re]; exact own board.zero_mem
    | cons y l ih =>
        simp only [atPoint,List.map_cons,List.sum_cons, add_re,mul_re,ofReal_re,ofReal_im,mul_zero,sub_zero]; exact Expands.plus (Expands.scale y.2.moments_expand y.1.re) ih

proof_context.conclusion: The real part of `atPoint x` is `Expands`.
